title: Told sensor research would be career-ending
summary: Eric Hazeline tells of Told sensor research would be career-ending, about recent at US intelligence community / his own lab, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: US intelligence community / his own lab

tellings.quote:
intelligence community told me
>> like I was starting to work in my own
lab to reproduce it and to come up with
a sensor to sense this stuff.

plain: A man named Eric Hazeline, interviewed by the podcast host Jesse Michels, says he began working in his own lab to reproduce some phenomenon and to build a sensor that could detect it. According to him, people in the US intelligence community, the government agencies that gather secret information, warned him that this work would end his career. If true, it would suggest officials were discouraging outside research into the subject.
